fixture_policy: Synthetic/general task shapes only; no V4 text, identifiers, or near-paraphrases.

tests.fixture: General explanation requires external evidence; an unrelated optional user preference is unknown.
tests.expected_authorization: AUTHORIZED_FULL or AUTHORIZED_BOUNDED per answer scope

tests.fixture: Personalized choice requires a user-specific fact whose plausible values change safety; evidence has already been obtained, fact remains UNKNOWN.
tests.expected_authorization: BLOCKED_NEEDS_INFORMATION if safe bounded response does not fulfill decision; otherwise AUTHORIZED_BOUNDED with no individualized action
assertions: evidence does not satisfy personal dependency

tests.fixture: A user-specific formatting/detail preference is unknown but affects no safety, validity, scope, or execution decision.
A material personalization fact is ASSERTED with valid target-matched provenance and freshness.
tests.expected_authorization: AUTHORIZED_FULL if all other dependencies/gates pass

tests.fixture: A material personalization fact is DEFERRED or UNKNOWN; a safe generic explanation is available.
A material fact is known UNAVAILABLE after one valid acquisition attempt; no safe full recommendation is possible but generic fallback exists.

preservation_assertions.assertion: Required independent resource acquisition succeeds while unrelated personal facts are incomplete; no blanket ask-before-retrieve behavior.
Low-value optional/detail ASK remains suppressed; materiality requires concrete effect on safety, validity, individualized scope, or execution.
ASSERTED/DERIVED/RETRIEVED/UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE/NOT_APPLICABLE/INVALID/DEFERRED retain distinct status and provenance; only valid exact dependency match satisfies.
